content: PDF download with auth header: plain <a href> or window.open cannot attach an Authorization header, so it fails against protected endpoints or requires insecure workarounds (token in query string, logged in access logs). Correct pattern: fetch() with Authorization header, response.blob(), URL.createObjectURL(blob), assign to temporary <a download>, then IMMEDIATELY URL.revokeObjectURL(url) after download starts - forgetting the revoke is the most common bug, especially in list/table UIs downloading many PDFs in one session. Alternative for large/streamed PDFs: short-lived signed URL endpoint (mint expiring download token server-side) avoiding exposure of the primary JWT in a URL.
